classes.name: construction loan
classes.label: construction loan
classes.definition: loan covering construction and development costs, secured by a mortgage on the property financed

classes.name: construction type
classes.label: construction type
classes.definition: particular kind of construction

classes.name: ethnicity
classes.label: ethnicity
classes.definition: category based on a cultural factors, including nationality, regional culture, ancestry, and language

classes.name: HMDA covered loan contract
classes.label: HMDA covered loan contract
classes.definition: a closed-end mortgage loan or open-end line of credit that is not an excluded transaction for HMDA reporting under US section 1003.3(c) of the Revised Home Mortgage Disclosure Act of 2015

classes.name: HMDA disposition
classes.label: HMDA disposition
classes.definition: a type of action taken regarding an application for a HMDA covered loan

classes.name: HMDA pre-approval request
classes.label: HMDA pre-approval request
classes.definition: a request for pre-approval of a home purchase loan up to a certain amount, and subject to certain non-credit related conditions

classes.name: HMDA report
classes.label: HMDA report
classes.definition: a report prepared to satisfy HMDA regulatory reporting requirements as described US section 1003.3(c) of the Revised Home Mortgage Disclosure Act of 2015

classes.name: how submitted
classes.label: how submitted
classes.definition: category indicating whether the applicant or borrower submitted the application for the covered loan directly to the reporting financial institution

classes.name: race
classes.label: race
classes.definition: a category based on a person's physical characteristics, such as bone structure and skin, hair, or eye color

classes.name: universal loan identifier
classes.label: universal loan identifier
classes.definition: unique identifier given to unequivocally identify a specific loan secured by real estate

classes.name: amortization type
classes.label: amortization type
classes.definition: classifier of amortization algorithms

classes.name: automated system
classes.label: automated system
classes.definition: system that reduces or eliminates the need for human involvement in order to complete a task

classes.name: automated underwriting system
classes.label: automated underwriting system
classes.definition: software system that collects the information necessary to approve a loan application and supports a mortgage lender's analysis of a new loan application

classes.name: cash-out status
classes.label: cash-out status
classes.definition: classifier indicating the extent to which funds are released to the borrower on a new loan origination that refinances an existing loan

classes.name: charge category
classes.label: charge category
classes.definition: Examples include closing costs, interest, taxes, and other service-related fees.

classes.name: dwelling capacity
classes.label: dwelling capacity
classes.definition: classifier indicating how many dwellings some property has

classes.name: manufactured home legal classification
classes.label: manufactured home legal classification
classes.definition: category indicating whether the covered loan is secured by a manufactured home only or with land as well

classes.name: mortgage indemnity guarantee
classes.label: mortgage indemnity guarantee
classes.definition: insurance-backed guarantee that protects lenders if the mortgage repayments cease for some reason, perhaps due to death or a homeowner being made redundant at work

classes.name: mortgage indemnity guarantor
classes.label: mortgage indemnity guarantor
classes.definition: guarantor and insurer that provides mortgage insurance in the form of a mortgage indemnity guarantee (MIG)

classes.name: mortgage indemnity insurance policy
classes.label: mortgage indemnity insurance policy
classes.definition: insurance policy providing the mortgage indemnity guarantee

classes.name: mortgage loan purpose
classes.label: mortgage loan purpose
classes.definition: the purpose for which mortgage loan proceeds will be used, such as real property purchase, dwelling construction, or loan refinancing

classes.name: Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry Identifier
classes.label: Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry Identifier
classes.definition: the number permanently assigned by the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) for each company, branch, and individual that maintains a single account on NMLS.

classes.name: property usage
classes.label: property usage
classes.definition: a category indicating the manner in which the borrower intends to utilize the property

classes.name: closed-end mortgage loan
classes.label: closed-end mortgage loan
classes.definition: loan secured by real estate with no ability for the borrower to receive additional funds under the loan at a later date

classes.name: closed-end reverse mortgage
classes.label: closed-end reverse mortgage
classes.definition: reverse mortgage that provides a lump sum payment to the borrower at closing, with no ability for the borrower to receive additional funds under the mortgage at a later date

classes.name: loan secured by real estate
classes.label: loan secured by real estate
classes.definition: loan that, at origination, is secured wholly or substantially by a lien or liens on real property for which the lien or liens are central to the extension of the credit - that is, the borrower would not have been extended credit in the same amount or on terms as favorable without the lien or liens on real property

classes.name: mortgage
classes.label: mortgage
classes.definition: grant of financial interest in real property to a party that is not an owner of that real property and is recorded by a registration authority

classes.name: open-end mortgage loan
classes.label: open-end mortgage loan
classes.definition: loan secured by real estate with a provision that the outstanding loan amount may be increased upon mutual agreement of the lender and the borrower

classes.name: open-end reverse mortgage
classes.label: open-end reverse mortgage
classes.definition: reverse mortgage structured like a home equity line of credit in that it provides the borrower with additional funds after closing (either as fixed monthly payments, under a line of credit, or both)

classes.name: reverse mortgage loan
classes.label: reverse mortgage loan
classes.definition: loan secured by real estate that pays money to the borrower against a set principal limit based on the value of existing equity in the underlying collateral

edges.name: has maximum allowed balance
edges.label: has maximum allowed balance
edges.definition: maximum balance that may be outstanding at any time, below the credit limit, for loans with flexible re-draw facilities

edges.name: has maximum anticipated balance
edges.label: has maximum anticipated balance
edges.definition: maximum balance the borrower believes they might need, below the credit limit, for planning purposes, for loans with flexible re-draw facilities

edges.name: has milestone maximum drawdown amount
edges.label: has milestone maximum drawdown amount
edges.definition: maximum amount of the loan that can be drawn by the borrower on completion of the milestone

edges.name: HMDA disposition date
edges.label: HMDA disposition date
edges.definition: the date associated with the HMDA Disposition for a HMDA Covered Loan

edges.name: assumes
edges.label: assumes
edges.definition: relates a new mortgage loan contract to a previous one made to a different borrower for the same property. The new contract is created via a legally binding process where the new borrower assumes the terms of the previous loan contract

edges.name: has originating service provider
edges.label: has originating service provider
edges.definition: relates something, typically a loan contract, to the service provider responsible for originated the loan

edges.name: has originator person
edges.label: has originator person
edges.definition: relates something, typically a loan, to a person that initially originates or creates it

edges.name: has initial funding date
edges.label: has initial funding date
edges.definition: relates a mortgage to the date on which the contract is consummated, officially creating the obligations therein

attributes.name: has number of affordable dwelling units
attributes.label: has number of affordable dwelling units
attributes.definition: relates real estate to the number of dwelling units it contains that are income-restricted under Federal, State, or local affordable housing programs.

attributes.name: has number of dwelling units
attributes.label: has number of dwelling units
attributes.definition: relates real estate to the number of dwelling units it contains

attributes.name: is ARM convertible
attributes.label: is ARM convertible
attributes.definition: indicates whether or not the loan can be converted into an adjustable-rate mortgage contract (ARM)
